description: Monthly Electricity Statistics is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy demand", published or maintained by IEA (International Energy Agency (IEA)). This dataset, updated monthly, provides electricity production and trade data for OECD Member Countries and electricity production data for a selection of other economies. Coverage: Sub-Saharan Africa, East Asia and the Pacific, Europe and Central Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, the Middle East and North Africa, South Asia. It has 1 file in CSV. The portal files it under Energy demand. The portal gives 2022 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is restricted or on request according to the listing; the conditions were not read. The licence is other closed licence (terms not stated in the catalogue entry). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
